notes: AKU-PAL Hieratogramm (HT) 11851; AKU grapheme Y0060 (AKU GR 737). Gold = the grapheme's MdC code(s) as given by AKU-PAL: Y8 (std). Möller numbers listed by AKU-PAL for this grapheme: 539. Source publication of this facsimile: Möller 1927a, p. 51, no. 539. Occurrence: line 2; find place Ägypten (unlokalisiert); writing direction "Zeilen, linksläufig prograd"; sign size 12.3 x 4.9 mm (h x w). AKU dating: "Zweite Zwischenzeit, 17. Dynastie". Facsimile type: Retro-Digitalisat (Publikation), by Georg Möller. Source scan (WEBP) converted to PNG at native resolution, flattened onto white, white margin added.
